name: _corpus_now swallows a missing corpus as an empty one
edits:
if not reviews.is_dir():
            raise OSError(f"the review corpus is not a directory: {reviews}")

if False:
            raise OSError(f"the review corpus is not a directory: {reviews}")
expect: ...and the message NAMES the path, so the remedy is not guessed at
_why_this_label: Removing the is_dir guard does NOT reach the handler: Path.rglob on a missing directory yields nothing and raises nothing, so it falls through to the empty-corpus error. The first case (median is None AND error is truthy) still PASSES — it was too weak, checking that there IS an error rather than that it is the RIGHT one. The message case is what distinguishes 'the corpus is not there' from 'the corpus is empty', which are different remedies.
